changes.before: Moving builds static charge. At full charge, attacks transfer it to the target, while being attacked causes a discharge onto yourself. Lightning strikes after 2 seconds, strengthened by damage taken during that time.
changes.after: Move to charge. Your next melee hit marks the target. Getting hit marks you instead. Damage taken over 2s powers the bolt.
